result.brief: 提出 LeCuration 小型世界模型，以 LeWM 潜编码器/预测器加 DiT 解码器实现自回归游戏状态预测，并将潜嵌入用于异常检测与内容聚类以策展数据。
result.reason: Trains a small latent world model (LeWM encoder/predictor + DiT decoder) for autoregressive gameplay rollout and embedding-based curation, directly contributing to video world models and latent representation learning.
